content: {"reasoning":"The claim is within timely filing, eligibility is active, COB order and diagnosis pairing are valid, and prior authorization is not required. With no denial or information request, appeal, peer-to-peer, retro-authorization, and patient or secondary billing are premature. Similar claims were paid substantially more often when submitted with records (13/17) than when submitted clean (3/7), so attaching the available documentation is the best initial path.","action":"submit_with_records"}
